title: ACARE: Agent-Context-Aware Reranker for Iterative Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.35840v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In agentic search, a document can match an agent-generated sub-query without helping answer the user's original question. Conventional rerankers score documents against the sub-query alone, overlooking the broader task and the agent's reasoning. We introduce the Agent-Context-Aware Reranker (ACARe), a compact 4B LLM trained to rerank documents using this context when available. Across multiple benchmarks and agent families, ACARe improves retrieval quality over its base reranker while reducing search effort. These benefits extend to answer generation: ACARe improves accuracy and reduces searches over no reranking, while matching or exceeding the base reranker's mean accuracy with more precise evidence. It also helps smaller agents narrow the retrieval-quality gap to larger agents, showing how better retrieval tools can make smaller agents more effective. The model, training data, and code will be released soon.

translated_title: ACARE：面向迭代搜索的智能体上下文感知重排序器
translated_abstract: 在智能体搜索中，一篇文档可能匹配了智能体生成的子查询，却无助于回答用户的原始问题。传统重排序器仅针对子查询对文档进行评分，忽略了更宏观的任务背景和智能体的推理过程。我们提出了智能体上下文感知重排序器（ACARe），这是一个紧凑的40亿参数大语言模型，经训练可在上下文可用时利用该上下文对文档进行重排序。在多个基准测试和多种智能体系上，ACARe 在提升检索质量的同时降低了搜索成本。这些优势还延伸到答案生成阶段：与不使用重排序相比，ACARe 提高了准确率并减少了搜索次数，同时以更精准的证据达到或超过基础重排序器的平均准确率。它还能帮助较小的智能体缩小与大智能体在检索质量上的差距，表明更好的检索工具可以让小型智能体更加高效。模型、训练数据和代码即将发布。
tldr: ACARe 是一个40亿参数的智能体上下文感知重排序器，通过利用任务背景与智能体推理信息对文档重排序，在提升检索质量和答案准确率的同时减少搜索次数，并帮助小型智能体缩小与大智能体的差距。
en_tdlr: ACARe is a compact 4B LLM reranker that leverages the agent's task context and reasoning to rerank documents, improving retrieval quality and answer accuracy while reducing search effort and helping smaller agents close the gap with larger ones.
